name: Bullies
overview: Scripture addresses the issue of bullies by calling believers to love their neighbors and refrain from vengeance or grudges, as seen in Leviticus 19:18. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting that God will never forsake them amid opposition (Deuteronomy 31:6). Wisdom teaches restraint and understanding rather than despising others (Proverbs 11:12), while mocking the vulnerable is equated with reproaching God Himself (Proverbs 17:5). Christ warns that anger and contempt toward others lead to serious judgment, emphasizing the need for righteous conduct even in the face of provocation (Matthew 5:22).
